claim.context: Think about that, any time in the history of our country, more working today and 100 percent of all jobs created under my administration have been in the private sector. || We ended DEI in America. || We cut a record number of job killing regulations and, in one year, we have lifted 2.4 million Americans, a record, off of food stamps.

row.reasoning: absolute 'ended DEI' is contradicted by evidence that DEI persists under rebranding and that courts largely blocked the EOs, despite real federal rollback actions

evidence.snippet: [2025-01-20] Presidential Executive Order directing termination of federal DEI/DEIA offices, grants, mandates, and related policies.
[2026-02-20] One year on, companies are rebranding rather than ending DEI; efforts continue under new labels, contradicting 'ended.'
[2025-01-29] Official Federal Register publication of EO 14151, text requiring agencies to end federal DEI programs and preferences.
[2026-02-20] Reports companies quietly rebranding, not eliminating, DEI work — diversity efforts persist under different terminology.
[2025-02-05] OPM memorandum to agency heads instructing elimination of DEIA offices, programs, ERG limits, and related actions.
[2025-02-21] Federal judge largely blocked Trump's DEI executive orders as likely unconstitutional, limiting their enforcement.
[2025-02-05] Attorney General memo directing DOJ Civil Rights Division to investigate and recommend enforcement against "illegal" DEI in private sector and education.
[2025-02-14] Department of Education "Dear Colleague" letter interpreting Title VI to limit many DEI practices at federally funded institutions.
[2025-01-23] GSA directive implementing EOs by rescinding internal DEI plans and instructing removal of DEI references from GSA materials.
